cohort: The study included 1292 newly-married women and their partners in Liuyang, China, who were assessed at a median of 23.3 weeks before a singleton pregnancy.
finding: Infant birthweight increased with both maternal (42.2 g per unit BMI) and paternal (10.7 g per unit BMI) pregravid BMI, though maternal weight had a dominant impact, and paternal BMI was not independently associated with LGA or SGA.
